p0004.s003: It has been strenuously contended by the learned counsel for the appellant that as, (i) the United Automo- biles is a distributor of the product manufactured by the appellant on the basis of commission, (ii) it pays the same amount to the appellant as the rent of the premises payable by the appellant to the respondent, and (iii) is entitled to be in possession only as long as it continues to be a dis- tributor, it should be held to be an 'associate concern' within the meaning of the aforementioned term of the lease.
